title: Expression and Purification of GST-Tagged ATG8 Proteins in E. coli
author: Elisabeth Holzer
materials: Continue incubation until the OD₆₀₀ reaches ~0.8.

steps.title: Inoculate cells in TY medium
steps.instruction: Inoculate E. coli Rosetta™ (DE3) pLysS cells carrying the plasmid into 2× TY medium and incubate at 37 °C with shaking.

steps.title: Grow to mid‑log phase
steps.instruction: Monitor the culture OD₆₀₀; when it reaches approximately 0.4, reduce the incubation temperature to 18 °C.

steps.title: Induce protein expression
steps.instruction: Add IPTG to the culture to a final concentration of 100 µM.

steps.title: Post‑induction incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the induced culture at 18 °C for 16 h (16:00:00) with shaking.

steps.title: Harvest cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture at 4 000 × g for 20 min (00:20:00) at 4 °C and collect the cell pellet.

steps.title: Wash pellet and freeze
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet once with ice‑cold 1× PBS (optional), then flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C until purification.

steps.title: Resuspend in lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the frozen cell pellets in ice‑cold lysis buffer.

steps.title: Lyse cells by sonication
steps.instruction: Sonicate the suspension on ice for two cycles of 30 s each at 60 % amplitude.

steps.title: Clarify lysate by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 18 000 rpm (≈38 000 × g) for 45 min (00:45:00) at 4 °C in a Sorvall RC6+ centrifuge (F21S‑8x50Y rotor) and collect the supernatant (cleared lysate).

steps.title: Equilibrate glutathione beads
steps.instruction: Equilibrate Glutathione Sepharose 4B beads in standard wash buffer.

steps.title: Bind protein to beads
steps.instruction: Incubate the cleared lysate with the equilibrated beads for 2 h (02:00:00) at 4 °C on a rotating wheel.

substeps.instruction: Twice again with standard wash buffer

steps.title: Elute bound protein
steps.instruction: Elute the GST‑tagged protein either by adding elution buffer (50 mM reduced glutathione in standard wash buffer) or by incubating the beads with TEV protease in standard wash buffer overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Remove beads and filter
steps.instruction: Centrifuge to pellet the beads, then filter the supernatant through a 0.45 µm filter.

steps.title: Concentrate eluate
steps.instruction: Concentrate the filtered eluate using 10 kDa Amicon centrifugal filters.

steps.title: Size‑exclusion chromatography
steps.instruction: Load the concentrated protein onto a Superdex 200 Increase 10/300 GL column equilibrated in SEC buffer and collect fractions.

steps.title: Analyze fractions by SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Analyze collected fractions by SDS‑PAGE to identify those containing the target protein.

steps.title: Finalize protein storage
steps.instruction: Pool the desired fractions, concentrate the pooled protein, aliquot, snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.
